intro: The Republic of the Congo has about 6 million people, most living in two cities.

chapters.title: People
text: The Kongo are the largest group. French is official, and Lingala and Kituba are widely spoken. Most people are Christian. Indigenous forest peoples, the Aka and Baka, face discrimination.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire are home to most people.
